build_substrate: build a substrate definition for the pure coordination in the matrix game with given roles and config
create_scene: create the global scene with TheMatrix component and stochastic episode ending
create_prefabs: create a dictionary of prefab game objects including walls, spawn points, and three resource types
create_avatar_objects: create avatar objects for a given number of players with self vs other sprite mapping
get_config: get the default configuration with action set, observation names, and timestep specs
